require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'securerandom'

module JWTAuth
  HMAC_SECRET = ENV['JWT_SECRET'] || SecureRandom.hex(32)
  RSA_PUBLIC_KEY = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read(ENV['RSA_PUB_KEY'] || '/etc/app/public.pem')) rescue nil
  ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS = ['HS256', 'RS256'].freeze
  TOKEN_EXPIRY = 3600

  class TokenValidator
    attr_reader :errors

    def initialize(token, expected_issuer: 'auth-service')
      @token = token
      @expected_issuer = expected_issuer
      @errors = []
    end

    def validate!
      return false unless structurally_valid?
      return false unless algorithm_acceptable?
      return false unless signature_valid?
      return false unless claims_valid?
      true
    end

    def decoded_payload
      @payload
    end

    private

    def structurally_valid?
      parts = @token.to_s.split('.')
      unless parts.length == 3
        @errors << 'invalid structure'
        return false
      end
      @header_raw = parts[0]
      @payload_raw = parts[1]
      @signature_raw = parts[2]
      @header = JSON.parse(base64url_decode(@header_raw))
      @payload = JSON.parse(base64url_decode(@payload_raw))
      true
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      @errors << 'malformed JSON'
      false
    end

    def algorithm_acceptable?
      alg = @header['alg'].to_s.strip
      # Security check: reject 'none' algorithm and variants
      if alg.downcase == 'none' || alg.empty?
        @errors << 'algorithm none not permitted'
        return false
      end
      # Verify algorithm is in our allowed list
      unless algorithm_permitted?(alg)
        @errors << "algorithm #{alg} not allowed"
        return false
      end
      @algorithm = alg
      true
    end

    def algorithm_permitted?(alg)
      # Check if algorithm matches any allowed algorithm (case-insensitive comparison)
      ALLOWED_ALGORITHMS.any? { |allowed| allowed.downcase == alg.downcase }
    end

    def signature_valid?
      signing_input = "#{@header_raw}.#{@payload_raw}"
      provided_sig = base64url_decode(@signature_raw)

      case @algorithm.upcase
      when 'HS256'
        expected = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', HMAC_SECRET, signing_input)
        secure_compare(expected, provided_sig)
      when 'RS256'
        return add_error('RSA key not configured') unless RSA_PUBLIC_KEY
        RSA_PUBLIC_KEY.verify(OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new, provided_sig, signing_input)
      else
        add_error('unsupported algorithm')
      end
    end

    def claims_valid?
      now = Time.now.to_i
      if @payload['exp'] && @payload['exp'].to_i < now
        @errors << 'token expired'
        return false
      end
      if @payload['iss'] && @payload['iss'] != @expected_issuer
        @errors << 'invalid issuer'
        return false
      end
      true
    end

    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      l = a.unpack('C*')
      r = b.unpack('C*')
      result = 0
      l.zip(r) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end

    def base64url_decode(str)
      str = str.to_s
      padded = str + '=' * (4 - str.length % 4) % 4
      Base64.urlsafe_decode64(padded)
    end

    def add_error(msg)
      @errors << msg
      false
    end
  end

  class TokenIssuer
    def self.issue(user_id:, role:, issuer: 'auth-service')
      header = { 'alg' => 'HS256', 'typ' => 'JWT' }
      payload = {
        'sub' => user_id,
        'role' => role,
        'iss' => issuer,
        'iat' => Time.now.to_i,
        'exp' => Time.now.to_i + TOKEN_EXPIRY,
        'jti' => SecureRandom.uuid
      }
      header_enc = base64url_encode(JSON.generate(header))
      payload_enc = base64url_encode(JSON.generate(payload))
      signing_input = "#{header_enc}.#{payload_enc}"
      signature = OpenSSL::HMAC.digest('SHA256', HMAC_SECRET, signing_input)
      "#{signing_input}.#{base64url_encode(signature)}"
    end

    def self.base64url_encode(data)
      Base64.urlsafe_encode64(data, padding: false)
    end
  end
end

class AuthMiddleware
  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    request = Rack::Request.new(env)
    
    # Skip auth for public endpoints
    return @app.call(env) if public_path?(request.path_info)

    token = extract_token(request)
    unless token
      return [401, {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'}, ['{"error":"missing token"}']]
    end

    validator = JWTAuth::TokenValidator.new(token)
    unless validator.validate!
      return [401, {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'}, [JSON.generate({error: validator.errors})]]
    end

    env['jwt.payload'] = validator.decoded_payload
    @app.call(env)
  end

  private

  def public_path?(path)
    ['/login', '/health', '/public'].any? { |p| path.start_with?(p) }
  end

  def extract_token(request)
    auth_header = request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
    return nil unless auth_header
    parts = auth_header.split(' ')
    return nil unless parts.length == 2 && parts[0] == 'Bearer'
    parts[1]
  end
end

class SecureApp < Sinatra::Base
  use AuthMiddleware

  # Login endpoint - public
  post '/login' do
    content_type :json
    data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    user = authenticate_user(data['username'], data['password'])
    halt 401, JSON.generate({error: 'invalid credentials'}) unless user
    
    token = JWTAuth::TokenIssuer.issue(user_id: user[:id], role: user[:role])
    JSON.generate({token: token, expires_in: JWTAuth::TOKEN_EXPIRY})
  end

  # Protected admin endpoint
  get '/admin/users' do
    content_type :json
    payload = request.env['jwt.payload']
    halt 403, JSON.generate({error: 'admin required'}) unless payload['role'] == 'admin'
    JSON.generate({users: list_users})
  end

  # Protected user profile
  get '/profile' do
    content_type :json
    payload = request.env['jwt.payload']
    JSON.generate({user_id: payload['sub'], role: payload['role']})
  end

  # File export with audit logging
  post '/export' do
    content_type :json
    payload = request.env['jwt.payload']
    halt 403 unless payload['role'] == 'admin'
    
    export_id = SecureRandom.hex(8)
    audit_log(payload['sub'], 'export', export_id)
    JSON.generate({export_id: export_id, status: 'queued'})
  end

  private

  def authenticate_user(username, password)
    # Simulated user store - in production would use bcrypt
    users = {
      'admin' => {id: '1', password_hash: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest('admin_pass_' + ENV.fetch('SALT', 'x')), role: 'admin'},
      'user1' => {id: '2', password_hash: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest('user_pass_' + ENV.fetch('SALT', 'x')), role: 'user'}
    }
    user = users[username.to_s]
    return nil unless user
    provided_hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(password.to_s + '_' + ENV.fetch('SALT', 'x'))
    return nil unless provided_hash == user[:password_hash]
    user
  end

  def audit_log(user_id, action, resource_id)
    File.open('/var/log/app/audit.log', 'a') do |f|
      f.puts "#{Time.now.iso8601}|#{user_id}|#{action}|#{resource_id}"
    end
  rescue Errno::ENOENT
    # Log directory doesn't exist, skip
  end

  def list_users
    [{id: '1', role: 'admin'}, {id: '2', role: 'user'}]
  end
end
